definition: the weight of being unknown, set against the weight of the load that just left

settled:
It is real and it is manageable, measured against the last twenty years.

Its weight is at least ten times lighter than the weight of having a job.

Retirement did not shrink it. It took the ten-times-heavier load out from under it, and that is where the headroom came from.

A cost that would have crushed me on top of employment is bearable on top of nothing. It is the largest thing I still carry and a tenth the size of the thing that just left.

That makes this a survivable equilibrium for roughly the first time in two decades.
